terminology: Super Intelligence (SI), as defined in the supplied NASA Space Apps Challenge submission rule
scope: Project-level disclosure of documented use; not an exhaustive per-file or per-line authorship inventory

si_generation_and_assistance: Generating and revising application code and scientific interfaces
Writing deterministic ingestion, normalization and validation tooling
Writing tests, browser automation and capture tooling

data.si_assistance: Research organization, summaries, interpretations and code for deterministic processing of attributed source records
data.derived_records: Deterministic source transformations; SI assistance applies to processing code, not fabrication of observations
data.provenance: Existing source manifests, identifiers, hashes and provenance records retain their original meaning
data.missing_measurements: Remain unknown; SI output is not a replacement for experimental evidence

documentation_and_media.si_assistance: Drafting descriptive text and writing capture and editing automation
documentation_and_media.readme_screenshots: Browser-rendered application captures using Codex-authored Playwright automation, with disclosure embedded in PNG metadata; no generative image synthesis

runtime.ember: Deterministic retrieval and structured answer composition; no external generative language model for scientific answers

branding.supplied_rule: SI-generated content may not use, contain or modify NASA branding or design elements, including logos, flags or mission identifiers
branding.compliance_audit: Not established by this disclosure; submission assets require team review
